title: tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig:177 uses hardcoded UUID (T010) instead of per-test generation
scope: tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig only. The defect is in the PAR-02 test fixture, not the production PAR-02 code path.
symptom: `zig build test-env-verify` fails the C5 test-isolation gate because tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig uses a fixed UUID literal at line 177 instead of generating a per-test UUID. This is a test-fixture defect, not a production PAR-02 defect.
description: The PAR-02 integration test fixture reuses a hardcoded UUID (`00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000ff`) as the instance_id in the events-table assertions. The fixed literal violates the T010 test-isolation rule and makes the fixture non-isolated across runs. The defect is in the PAR-02 test fixture itself, not in the production PAR-02 implementation.
root_cause: The test fixture hardcodes a single UUID instead of generating a new UUID per test case. The repeated fixed value causes C5 isolation lint failures and conflates test results across runs.
acceptance_criteria: Replace the hardcoded UUID in tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig with a per-test-generated UUID
The file no longer violates T010 isolation rules
`python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration` and `zig build test-env-verify` pass C5 once the fixture is fixed
